Quick runtime analysis notes:
- Reproduced a stall locally using the provided repro (thanks Alex). The combination of batching + prefetch appears to create a race where a KV cache flush and a prefetch coroutine overlap; the prefetch try/await path can observe a stale pointer during long-context attention, which hangs the token generation loop until a background GC/flush resolves it.
- This is most noticeable on hosts running with higher batch sizes and on models with large KV footprints (redwood-7b-v2 fits that profile).

Mitigation options (trade-offs):
1) Hotfix in runtime: add a short guard in the prefetch code path that validates KV pointer stability and retries with exponential backoff (canary 48–72h). Low customer impact and quick to push.
2) SDK change: make prefetch opt-in with stronger defaults (disable by default in next SDK release). Requires SDK release cycle and may be breaking for customers relying on current defaults.
3) Customer-side workaround: advise BrightLane to set prefetch=false and reduce client-side batch size.

I prefer option (1) for speed; I'll prepare a minimal patch branch (runtime/patch/prefetch-safety) and propose a canary on Dedicated nodes. Steps to reproduce included in the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4579.

— Karthik (Runtime Lead)

Subject: Re: Intermittent generation stalls after SDK 1.8.1 upgrade — workaround & next steps

Alex — thanks for the report and for the repro payload. Quick summary and next steps: 

What we found: a rare interaction between SDK prefetch=true and runtime batching that can stall token generation for long-context requests. Runtime lead suspects a prefetch/KV pointer race.

Immediate workaround (please try and confirm):
1) Set prefetch=false in your SDK client config.
2) Reduce client-side batch size by 1 (if you were at 8, try 7).
3) Increase the client streaming timeout to 60s to tolerate transient stalls while we patch.

We will:
- Push a runtime hotfix that adds a safety/retry guard in the prefetch path (canary within 48–72 hours).
- If the canary looks stable we'll expand the rollout and follow up with a patch release note.

Attachments: workaround-snippet-prefetch.patch.txt (tiny code sample to toggle prefetch in JS SDK), brightlane-req-logs-20260815.txt (your logs we referenced).

I'll follow up with timing as we progress on the canary. If you prefer we can schedule a 30-min call to walk through the workaround now.

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
